description:
Score an EPCIS document across every conformance dimension at once, including whether it
used the identifiers it was given. Use this as a final self-check before presenting a
document to a user.

Pass suppliedText as what the user actually told you, verbatim — their whole request is
fine. This is the only way to detect a FABRICATED identifier, which passes every other
check and yet describes a different physical object. Leave it empty only when the user
genuinely supplied nothing.

suppliedText.description: What the user told you, verbatim

name: checkEpcisConformance
title: Check EPCIS conformance
